title: Wayfare Pass Restoration Payment — Calculation Sheet
content:
# Restoration payment — calculation sheet (Wayfare Pass)

**Definition.** The restoration payment of a past-due Wayfare Pass (rider membership) membership is the plan's membership fee for the billing period in force. It is rounded half up to the cent, once, as the final amount of the payment.

## Inputs

| Input | Where it is read |
|---|---|
| The plan | The plan the membership is on, from the membership record |
| The plan's membership fee | The fee per billing period of that plan in the Wayfare Pass plan schedule |
| The billing period in force | The current period dates on the membership record |

## Worked figures (hypothetical memberships)

| Plan held | Membership fee for the period in force | Restoration payment |
|---|---|---|
| Wayfare Pass Monthly | 9.99 | 9.99 |
| Wayfare Pass Plus Monthly | 19.99 | 19.99 |
| Wayfare Pass Annual | 96.00 | 96.00 |

## Notes

- The amount is the fee of the plan the membership is on for the period in force, in USD.
- Rounding is half up to the cent and is applied once, to the final amount of the payment; no intermediate figure is rounded.
